root_cause.text: The b43legacy RX path fails to enforce a bounds check on the firmware-controlled key index before using it to index the dev->key[] array, relying only on a non-enforcing WARN_ON macro that allows an out-of-bounds read in production builds.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces the non-enforcing `B43legacy_WARN_ON(keyidx >= dev->max_nr_keys)` with an enforcing `if (B43legacy_WARN_ON(keyidx >= dev->max_nr_keys)) goto drop;`, preventing access to `dev->key[keyidx]` when the index is invalid. The CVE description explicitly states that the existing WARN_ON is non-enforcing and allows an out-of-bounds read.

intent_record.how: If keyidx is out of range (>= max_nr_keys), the packet is now dropped instead of just issuing a warning and continuing processing, preventing out-of-bounds access to the key array.
